title: Early Markers - Bayesian Surprise Analysis for Infant Developmental Risks
summary: A research codebase implementing Bayesian surprise analysis to detect developmental anomalies from infant movement feature data, including feature selection, ROC analysis, and sample-size estimation. Its 02_synthetic_sdv.ipynb notebook fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer (with CTGAN/CopulaGAN imported but unused) on the feature data to generate synthetic samples for validation and power analysis.
needs: CTGANSynthesizer/CopulaGANSynthesizer are imported but only appear commented out; only GaussianCopulaSynthesizer is actually instantiated and run.
